title: Kitton Stylist
description:
Kitton Stylist is an advanced stylist-sampler that can load up to 128 wave files at once and spread them on the keyboard as a continuous, multi-octave playable instrument.
`Main features:`
# 2 versions: multi-out and single out
# Loads up to 128 wav files at once
# Virtual keyboard with an octave switch
# Coarse and fine-tuning knobs
# Built-in flexible reverb
# A, D, S, R envelope
# Low / high pass filter
# Pan and volume knobs
# Multi-out version sends each of the 16 midi channels to a separate audio output in the DAW

Demo limitations: 3 seconds of silence every 15 seconds.
